_comment: Dashboard form for this poster. Read by studio/dashboard/dashboard.py; flags must match make.py's argparse. '@themes' and '@sizes' are expanded by the dashboard from studio/themes/ and posterlab.chrome.SIZES so the form never drifts from the code.

schema.label: Address
schema.help: Street / area to centre the map on (geocoded via Nominatim).

schema.label: Merge threshold (m)
schema.help: Merge playgrounds within this many metres (0 disables).

schema.label: Fetch buildings
schema.help: Also fetch house footprints under the streets. Box half-width capped at 1000 m.

schema.label: Mode
schema.help: standard = data only · poster = data + render · fresh = refetch + render.

schema.label: Theme
schema.help: Pick one, or 'All themes' to render every theme in one go.

schema.label: Numbered playgrounds
schema.help: How many nearest playgrounds to number.

schema.label: Numbering radius (m)
schema.help: Only number playgrounds within this many metres; farther ones in-frame become small dots. Blank = the search radius.

schema.label: Size
schema.help: A print size, 'bundle' (digital set), 'pod' (the three Prodigi-fulfilled cm sizes: 30x40, 40x50, 50x70), or 'all'.

schema.label: Variant
schema.help: clean = framable · annotate = adventure log · both.

schema.label: Frame radius (m)
schema.help: Frame a fixed box of this half-width around home instead of the playground spread. Blank = off.

schema.label: Write PNG preview
schema.help: Needed to show thumbnails on this dashboard.

schema.label: Assemble digital ZIP
schema.help: Bundle PDFs + how-to + licence into a download ZIP.
